name: Planning Poker
highLevelGoals: The moderator needs to be able to set up, run, and conclude Planning Poker games efficiently to help the team reach consensus on story estimates.
The moderator must have comprehensive control over the items being estimated, including adding, editing, deleting, and selecting them, to adapt to the team's needs during a session.
The moderator needs to access and manage past game data, including transcripts and estimates, for review, analysis, and record-keeping purposes.
The moderator requires functionalities to create, log in to, modify, and delete their personal account to ensure secure and personalized access to the application.
The moderator needs to configure game parameters such as estimation scales and participant limits to tailor the Planning Poker experience to their team's preferences.
The estimator needs to be able to join a game and submit their estimates for stories, contributing to the collective estimation process.
The estimator needs to view the current story being estimated and the overall list of stories to be estimated to make informed decisions.
The participant needs to see who has estimated what and observe the progress of the estimation round to facilitate discussion and reach consensus.
The participant needs to be able to initiate and manage a countdown timer to help keep discussions focused and within a reasonable timeframe.
The developer needs to build the application according to web standards, ensuring broad accessibility, cross-browser compatibility, and a smooth user experience.
The developer needs to implement technical optimizations, such as database indexing, to ensure the application responds quickly to user actions.
The researcher needs access to game data stored in a non-identifiable format to conduct studies on estimation patterns and team dynamics.
